tasks.short: Check stocks of grinding wheels, parts and tools on the shelves, record what is used, decide what to reorder, fill the reorder request, check it, send it to purchasing, and put deliveries away.

steps.what: Grinding machine operator checks stocks of machine parts and machining tools on the shelves
Grinding machine operator records parts and tools used on a paper list
Grinding machine operator decides which parts and tools to reorder
Grinding machine operator fills the reorder request by hand
Grinding machine operator checks the final reorder request
Grinding machine operator hands the request to purchasing
Grinding machine operator puts delivered parts and tools away

tasks.design: Grinding wheels, dressing tools and spare parts get bin labels, and the operator scans each item taken in the ERP shop-floor module ({ERP}), so usage is not written on a paper list and stock levels stay current; shelf checks become spot checks. A reorder list shows items below their minimum level, and the requisition is built from the items the operator picks. Once checked, it goes to purchasing in the system instead of on paper. Deciding what to reorder and putting deliveries away stay with the operator.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stock was checked by eye, usage written on paper and requests handed over on paper.
tasks.enabler_now: ERP shop-floor modules track stock by scan and build requisitions from minimum levels.
tasks.still_hard: Special wheels for one-off jobs have no minimum level.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing which wheel grade gives the right finish on a new material.
tasks.altitude: The operator decides on reorders instead of counting.

reach.learn: Whether requests arrive before stock runs out.

evidence.claim: Jay Industries reported 86% less inventory variance and 6% higher OEE with Plex MES; vendor case.
Scans tied to an operator login can observe performance and need works council consent.

assumptions: Boundary: from the shift start to stock replenished; supplier choice is outside.
Input contract: bins labelled and minimum levels set; fallback is the paper list.
Works council consent comes before scans are tied to logins.
research_questions: Do machine stops for missing wheels fall?

incremental.description: Grinding machine operator scans each item taken.

approvals.approved_version: The request as checked by the operator in s5.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: many one-off special wheels; high: mostly standard stock items.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The grinding machine operator keeps deciding what to reorder and handling tools; eye checks, paper usage lists and paper requests shrink.
role.ambitious_version: An operator with more time at the machine.
